_comment: Retention policy configuration. Human-readable, agent-tunable. Used by retention engine for entry lifecycle decisions.

discover_tools_result.notes: Forward once so model knows tools are available, then prune. Schemas live in tool payload.

list_directory_result.notes: Keep until directory state changes or TTL expires.

find_result.notes: Invalidate when searched files change or a newer search replaces it.

read_file_content.notes: Prune when overlapping edit happens. Keep disjoint reads of same file.

tool_data_hints.notes: Pagination hints, metadata. Keep for one decision, then strip.

edit_result.notes: Model may need edit confirmation. Short retention.

run_shell_result.notes: Longer TTL. Invalidate when dependencies change.

validation_error.notes: Send correction once, never persist to durable history.

oversized_output.notes: Write full output to tmp file. Keep preview + path + size + retrieval hint.

repeated_tool_call.notes: Deduplicate. Serve cached result if args + deps unchanged.

conversation_middle.notes: Cost engine decides when summarization is profitable. No hardcoded threshold.

dynamic_tool_retention.notes: retention_turns = minimum holding period before tool becomes eligible for cost-based removal. NOT automatic removal.
